items.title: Cisco Selects Lumentum 1.6T Optics for Next-Generation Platforms

paragraphs.text: Cisco selected Lumentum to supply 1.6T optical modules, and Lumentum began shipping these modules this quarter.
Cisco confirmed that Applied Optoelectronics and Lumentum both began shipping 800G modules this quarter.
